en.name: eabz/tirith
en.description: Coordination server for parallel coding agents working in one repository. The claim also returns the change notices, versioned interface contracts, decisions and path-scoped memory notes for those paths, so what one agent learned reaches the next one without a search. 22 tools across claims, a task board with dependencies, contracts, notices, a decisions log, memory notes and agent messages. Transport: stdio (`tirith stdio`) or Streamable HTTP at `http://127.0.0.1:7477/mcp`, with a live dashboard at `http://127.0.0.1:7477/`; local daemon, no auth, no telemetry, no embeddings. Clients: Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, LangGraph, CrewAI, or any MCP client. Install: `cargo install tirith-mcp` (crate `tirith-mcp`, binary `tirith`), or prebuilt macOS, Linux and Windows binaries for x86_64 and ARM64 via `curl -LsSf https://eabz.github.io/tirith/install.sh | sh`.
